intended_object: No mathematical object. Its docstring says it is a "checked nominal proof certificate", and it picks a fresh variable, the one avoiding the free variables of an auxiliary class term `nb095AlphaDummy002 D R S_cls E`, to use in an alpha-renaming step of a generated proof.
explanation: The body is just `freshVar (Class.cv (nb095AlphaDummy002 D R S_cls E)).fv 0`. This picks a dummy bound variable that does not occur in another auxiliary term. The name (`AlphaDummy253`), the namespace (`NominalAlphaWrappersRepaired`) and the docstring (an upstream proof-certificate identifier) all show that this is an implementation detail of machine-generated syntactic proofs, used to rename bound variables (alpha-conversion). It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature or in Mathlib.
